entities.name: HMG-CoA reductase
observations: The 768-residue query is a highly supported homolog of eukaryotic 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-CoA reductase (EC 1.1.1.34).
Homology to reviewed Xenopus laevis HMG-CoA reductase is 100% identity across 100% of the query; E-value 0.
The enzyme catalyzes NADPH-dependent reduction of HMG-CoA to mevalonate, the rate-limiting step of the mevalonate pathway.
Predicted Pfam domains include a sterol-sensing domain at residues 87–222 and HMG-CoA reductase catalytic domain at residues 487–767.
The N-terminal region is a multi-pass hydrophobic membrane module; the catalytic domain is in the C-terminal soluble region.
Sequence-derived properties: 768 aa, approximately 84.9 kDa, theoretical pI 5.70, predicted net charge at pH 7 approximately -9.7.
